content: I will update `renderClientPortalTeaser`'s outer container styling so that it no longer contains built-in top margins or borders, allowing it to serve elegantly as the first section of the Bespoke Furniture page.

args.Description: Adjust renderClientPortalTeaser styles for top positioning in Bespoke Furniture view
args.Instruction: Remove marginTop, borderTop, and set paddingTop to 0 so it aligns beautifully at the top of the tab.
args.TargetContent:
<div className="portal-teaser-container" style={{
        marginTop: '6rem',
        borderTop: '1px solid rgba(124, 114, 103, 0.15)',
        paddingTop: '5rem'
      }}>
